concepts.name: Electrolysis
concepts.simple_definition: Electrolysis is the process of using electrical energy to drive a non-spontaneous chemical reaction.
concepts.deep_explanation: Electric current enters through the anode (oxidation occurs) and leaves through the cathode (reduction occurs) inside an electrolyte solution.
concepts.real_example: Electrolysis of water splits water molecules into hydrogen gas at the cathode and oxygen gas at the anode.
concepts.common_confusion: Confusing anode and cathode polarities in electrolytic vs galvanic cells.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ኤሌክትሮላይሲስ ማለት የኤሌክትሪክ ኃይልን በመጠቀም ራሱን ችሎ የማይካሄድን ኬሚካላዊ ግብረመልስ የማካሄድ ሂደት ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: የኤሌክትሪክ ፍሰት በአኖድ በኩል ይገባል (ኦክሳይድ ይከናወናል) እንዲሁም በካቶድ በኩል ይወጣል (ሪዳክሽን ይከናወናል)።
concepts.real_example_amharic: የውሃ ኤሌክትሮላይሲስ ውሃን በመክፈል ሃይድሮጅን ጋዝ በካቶድ እና ኦክስጅን ጋዝ በአኖድ ላይ እንዲፈጠር ያደርጋል።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: በኤሌክትሮላይቲክ እና በጋልቫኒክ ሴሎች ውስጥ የአኖድ እና ካቶድ ምልክቶችን ማደናገር።

concepts.name: Natural Occurrence And Extraction Of Met
concepts.simple_definition: Natural occurrence and extraction of metals Noble metals Ag, Au, Bi, Cu, Pd, Pt exist in nature as uncombined or free state
concepts.deep_explanation: More active metals like alkali and alkaline earth metals never exist in uncombined state
concepts.real_example: Practical example of Natural occurrence and extraction of met from page 208.
concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse Natural occurrence and extraction of met with adjacent topics in Chapter 3.
concepts.name_amharic: Natural occurrence and extraction of met (በአማርኛ)
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: [አማርኛ] Natural occurrence and extraction of metals Noble metals Ag, Au, Bi, Cu, Pd, Pt exist in nature as uncombined or free state (ይህ ትርጓሜ በኢትዮጵያ የ10ኛ ክፍል ሥርዓተ-ትምህርት መሠረት የተዘጋጀ ነው)።

concepts.name: 205 Metals And Nonmetals SiO2 (s) + 2NaO
concepts.simple_definition: 205 Metals and Nonmetals SiO2 (s) + 2NaOH (aq) → Na2SiO3 (aq) + H2O (l) Insoluble soluble At the same time aluminum oxide is converted to soluble sodium aluminate
concepts.deep_explanation: Al2O3 (s) + 2NaOH (aq) → NaAlO2 (aq) + H2O (l) Insoluble soluble The impurities like iron oxides and titanium (IV) oxide remain unaffected by the base and are filtered off
concepts.real_example: Practical example of 205 Metals and Nonmetals SiO2 (s) + 2NaO from page 211.

concepts.name: Note That Under The Prevailing Condition
concepts.simple_definition: Note that under the prevailing conditions in the electrolytic cell, the anode (graphite electrode) will gradually oxidize to carbon dioxide and must be replaced regularly
concepts.deep_explanation: Molten aluminum is siphoned or drawn from the bottom of the electrolytic cell
